description: Source code for ARC4 encryption driver for Linux kernel, implementing cryptographic algorithms and hardware interaction for ARC4 cipher, including initialization, key setting, encryption/decryption, and driver registration.

methods.name: _deu_arc4
methods.description: Main interface to ARC4 hardware for encryption/decryption, processes data in chunks, handles hardware register interactions.

methods.name: arc4_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes ARC4 hardware; currently a placeholder doing nothing.

methods.name: arc4_set_key
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for ARC4 hardware, configuring hardware registers with key data.

methods.name: _deu_arc4_ecb
methods.description: Configures ARC4 hardware to operate in ECB mode for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: arc4_crypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts a block of data using ARC4, invoked by Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_arc4
methods.description: Initializes and registers ARC4 crypto algorithms with Linux kernel crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_arc4
methods.description: Unregisters ARC4 crypto algorithms from Linux kernel crypto API.
